name: Payment Target Prepared
description: Result emitted after MyOS Admin successfully prepares an opaque recipient payment target.

amount.description: Optional effective amount constraint echoed back to the caller.

currency.description: Optional effective currency constraint echoed back to the caller.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry echoed back to the caller.

allowedPayer.description: Optional effective payer restriction echoed back to the caller.

documentId.description: Blue document id identifying the business document this payment is for.

expectedPaynote.description: Optional effective PayNote matcher echoed back to the caller.
